    <content type="html"><h2>What's Changed</h2>
<p>Note: <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4851403971" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/issues/2369" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2369/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2369">#2369</a> deprecates the TUF client. Use the TUF client from sigstore-go instead: <a href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore-go/tree/main/pkg/tuf">https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore-go/tree/main/pkg/tuf</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Deprecate TUF client, ValidatePubKey in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4851403971" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/issues/2369" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2369/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2369">#2369</a></li>
<li>docs: add OVHcloud KMS in available external plugins in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4716490455" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/issues/2359" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2359/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2359">#2359</a></li>
<li>fix(oauthflow): default the device flow poll interval to 5s per RFC 8628 in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4948561016" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/issues/2381" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2381/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2381">#2381</a></li>
<li>Add BrowserOpener field to InteractiveIDTokenGetter in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5000472903" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/issues/2383" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2383/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2383">#2383</a></li>
<li>Fix Azure KMS support for RSA signatures in <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4640624614" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/issues/2355" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2355/hovercard" href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2355">#2355</a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Full Changelog</strong>: <a class="commit-link" href="https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/compare/v1.10.8...v1.10.9"><tt>v1.10.8...v1.10.9</tt></a></p></content>
